reason: A DSH plugin that statically analyzes dynamic Cordis plugin source, reports matched risk patterns, and requests user approval before activating packages with high- or critical-severity findings.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中对动态 Cordis 插件源码进行规则化静态审查，报告风险发现并在高危或严重发现时请求用户审批。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that statically scans dynamic Cordis plugin source, reports detected risk patterns, and requests user approval for high- or critical-severity findings.

capabilities: Scans dynamic Cordis plugin source code with static rules
Appends risk reports to tool results
Escalates high- and critical-severity findings to user approval
Intercepts cordis_define and cordis_run tool-pipeline events
Maintains an in-process LRU report cache
Logs internal scan errors while allowing audited calls to proceed
